lessons.title: Prenatal Development, Teratogens & Infant Capabilities
lessons.description: Explore zygotic to fetal stages, teratogen risks, newborn reflexes, and visual cliff depth perception.

lessons.title: Cognitive Development: Piaget & Vygotsky
lessons.description: Master Piaget's four stages, schemas, conservation, and Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development.

lessons.title: Social Development: Attachment & Parenting Styles
lessons.description: Analyze Harlow's monkeys, Ainsworth's Strange Situation attachment styles, and Baumrind's parenting grid.

lessons.title: Moral & Psychosocial Development across the Lifespan
lessons.description: Examine Erikson's 8 psychosocial crises, Kohlberg's moral stages, and adulthood transition theories.
